topic: How we work: one team for web, mobile and backend
caption:
Three vendors for web, mobile and backend? Or one team that builds the whole product? 🧩

We build full-stack, and here's why that helps founders:

▸ One API contract, designed once for web and mobile
▸ No finger-pointing when something breaks between layers
▸ One plan, one set of milestones, one place to ask questions

Web with React and Next.js, mobile with React Native, backend with Node.js, Python/FastAPI or .NET, all through our ISO-certified process. Swipe for more. →

Building a product with more than one piece? DM us TEAM and tell us what it needs.

Share this with a founder juggling vendors. 🔁
